title: Into the Deep
description: A cave-in opened a section of Willow Dale nobody has mapped, and Vorn has heard - from where, he won't say - that the Thieves Guild already sent someone in to look. Whatever is down there is Guild property only if the Guild's boot prints are the first ones in the dust. Map it, clear it, and anything you carry out is yours to keep. Watch for traps, and watch for anyone else's torchlight.

objectives.description: Get into the new section before whoever else is looking does
Map the chambers before somebody else does
Cut through the undead standing between you and the vault
Take the vault's artifact before it belongs to someone else's claim
Solve the vault puzzle to access the artifact

notes: Rank: Veteran. Dungeon exploration with traps and puzzles. Willow Dale deep section. Optional puzzle for bonus rewards. Boots give trap detection bonus. Threat: a rival claim on the same vault - the Thieves Guild, per Vorn's unconfirmed word. Giver motive: territorial control of a Guild asset, not treasure for its own sake. Consequence: arriving second costs the Guild the claim - stated in prose only, no rival encounter or flag exists to wire it; deferred.
